sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Wrapper for gas-power imports
sections.what: Forwards the whole command line to the shared population importer with the gas-power label, so the gas-power import runs exactly as before.
sections.why: The header says it preserves the earlier command line after the importer was made general.
sections.watch_out: The label gas-power must stay in step with the industry names the shared importer uses.

summary: A small wrapper that runs the general population importer with the gas-power industry name, so the old command line keeps working.
purpose: Keep the older gas-power import command working after the importer was made general.
why: The header says it accepts the same command line as before the importer became industry-generic.
how: Passes the command line arguments, minus the program name, to the shared population importer with the label gas-power.
inputs: Reply file paths and optional flags such as --commit, --approved-digest, and --report-name.
outputs: Whatever the shared population importer prints and saves.
risks: Changes to the shared importer affect this wrapper. The industry label must match a name the importer recognises.
debug: If this fails, look first at the shared importer in import-population.ts, since this file only forwards the command.
